asset_features.validation_notes: Feature generation works on synthetic asset snapshots; real asset history required for real baseline.

failure_prediction.validation_notes: Trained and calibrated on 72k synthetic rows. Blocked from production claims until substantial real failure logs arrive.

rul_prediction.validation_notes: RUL formula implemented and validated on simulated degradation curves.

survival_analysis.real_source: Blocked on real asset tenure data
survival_analysis.validation_notes: Cox PH model fitted on simulated lifespans.

maintenance_duration.validation_notes: Duration estimation prototype functional; needs completed maintenance records with actual duration.

traffic_forecasting.validation_notes: Corridor station sequence and real delay risk extracted from 8 RailKit captures.

operational_impact.validation_notes: Section-level delay risk and route intensity formula verified on NDLS-MMCT corridor.

maintenance_priority.real_source: Enriched by real RailKit section pressure
maintenance_priority.validation_notes: Multi-objective engine successfully incorporates real delay pressure (+0.035 to +0.052 score shifts).

block_optimization_single.validation_notes: Discrete 30-min slots, manpower limits, and section non-overlap tested and passing.

block_optimization_multi_horizon.validation_notes: Fully verified in test suite across 7-day, 30-day, and dynamic delay disruption scenarios.

anomaly_detection.validation_notes: Dual isolation forest + autoencoder anomaly scores computed on synthetic asset condition history.

deep_learning_sequence.validation_notes: Research candidates trained on CPU. XGBoost remains primary baseline until real evaluation proves superiority.

evidence_fusion.validation_notes: Combines failure risk, RUL, urgency, and operational context with confidence markers.

benchmark_validator.validation_notes: Proved CP-SAT optimization strictly outperforms uncoordinated FIFO scheduling.

standalone_ml_engine.validation_notes: Exposes health(), predict(), and generate_block_plan() for all planning horizons.
